summary: Iteration 36: iOS Native Bug Fixes Testing - All 18 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend web flows verified: login, create timesheet, create report (daily/service), admin pages (propostas, os-archive, timesheets, service-reports, daily-reports), edit timesheet. Code review confirms iOS fixes: (1) InlineCalendar and InlineTimePicker components render within entry form modal's ScrollView, (2) create-report.tsx uses Modal-based picker for native OS selection, (3) pdfHelper.ts prevents double-token in PDF URLs.

integration_issues.flow: Button clicks on React Native Web
integration_issues.issue: Known limitation - button clicks via Playwright don't work reliably on React Native Web due to overlay interception. Workaround: navigate directly to pages after login.
integration_issues.priority: LOW - Known limitation documented in previous iterations, not a bug

create-timesheet.tsx.details: InlineCalendar (lines 34-68) and InlineTimePicker (lines 72-87) components render directly within the entry form modal's ScrollView. No separate Modal wrappers for pickers. Uses openInlinePicker() to toggle visibility states (calendarVisible, employeePickerVisible, timePickerField).

edit-timesheet.tsx.details: Same InlineCalendar and InlineTimePicker pattern as create-timesheet.tsx. Pickers render inline within the entry form modal.

create-report.tsx.details: Web uses HTML <select> element (lines 103-115). Native uses Modal-based picker (lines 117-124, 226-244) with osModalVisible state. showMsg() uses window.alert on web, Alert.alert on native (lines 37-39).

propostas.tsx.details: PDF URL construction (lines 290-291) does NOT include token - only tipo and timestamp. Token is added by pdfHelper.ts. Uses downloadAndSharePDF for native PDF download.

pdfHelper.ts.details: Double-token fix confirmed (lines 30-33): checks if token already present in URL before adding. Ensures /api/ prefix in URL (line 29). Uses FileSystem.downloadAsync + Sharing.shareAsync for native.

critical_code_review_comments: InlineCalendar component (create-timesheet.tsx lines 34-68): Renders calendar grid directly in form, no Modal wrapper
InlineTimePicker component (create-timesheet.tsx lines 72-87): Renders FlatList of time slots directly in form, no Modal wrapper
openInlinePicker() function (line 285-289): Toggles visibility states for inline pickers, closes others when one opens
create-report.tsx native OS picker: Uses Modal (lines 226-244) with osModalVisible state, separate from web <select>
pdfHelper.ts double-token prevention: Line 31 checks !apiUrl.includes('token=') before adding token
seed_data_creation: Created test timesheet and proposals via API tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: iOS native fixes verified via code review: (1) InlineCalendar and InlineTimePicker components in create-timesheet.tsx and edit-timesheet.tsx render directly within the entry form modal's ScrollView - no separate Modal wrappers. (2) create-report.tsx uses Modal-based picker for native OS selection (osModalVisible state). (3) pdfHelper.ts prevents double-token by checking if token already present in URL. All backend APIs working (18/18 tests pass). Web flows verified: login, create/edit timesheet, create report, admin pages.

native_os_picker_in_create_report.showMsg_function: Uses window.alert on web, Alert.alert on native (lines 37-39)

pdf_double_token_fix.propostas_tsx: PDF URL (line 291) does NOT include token - only tipo and timestamp
pdf_double_token_fix.pdfHelper_ts: Line 31 checks !apiUrl.includes('token=') before adding token to prevent duplicates
